summer gift box.name: Summer Gift Box
summer gift box.story:
THE STORY

The Summer Gift Box brings together four considered essentials for the modern gentleman. A white ghutra and a traditional red-and-white Shumagh, both made from rare West Indian Sea Island cotton, offer exceptional softness and breathable comfort. They are accompanied by Swiss-made white thobe fabric, selected for its refined finish and suitability for warm-weather tailoring, and a complementary fragrance.

Presented as a complete gift, the collection celebrates the ease of summer dressing through fine materials, thoughtful craftsmanship and enduring Arabian style. An elegant choice for personal occasions or distinguished gifting.

The art of summer gifting
summer gift box.details: A curated summer gift selection celebrating light fabrics, fine accessories and thoughtful presentation.
summer gift box.passport: Includes Sea Island cotton ghutra and shumagh, Swiss-made thobe fabric and fragrance, as described in the collection. The cotton is prized for its softness and breathability; consult the selected box specification for exact contents.
summer gift box.care: Dry clean only. Store gently folded in a breathable cover, away from direct sunlight and moisture. Entrust delicate embroidery to a specialist cleaner.

winter gift box.name: Winter Gift Box
winter gift box.story:
THE STORY

Created for the cooler season, the Winter Gift Box brings together three expressions of Kashperia’s material expertise. A Shahmina ghutra shawl, crafted from exceptionally fine baby pashmina, offers lightness and warmth. Alongside it is a 3.50-metre cut of Super 160’s Italian wool fabric, developed in collaboration with Carlo Barbera for beautifully tailored attire. A signature fragrance completes the selection.

Each element has been chosen for its tactile quality and understated character. Elegantly presented, the set makes a thoughtful winter gift for those who appreciate fine textiles, personal style and the pleasure of considered details.

A considered winter selection
winter gift box.details: A considered winter gift pairing fine shawl craftsmanship with Italian tailoring fabric and fragrance.
winter gift box.passport: Features a Shahmina shawl and Italian Super 160 wool fabric by Carlo Barbera, together with fragrance, as described in the collection. Shahmina offers fine softness and warmth; the wool fabric brings refined structure.

ramadan gift box.name: Ramadan Gift Box
ramadan gift box.story:
THE STORY

A celebration of generosity and refined tradition, the Ramadan Gift Box presents a carefully chosen selection for meaningful gifting. It includes a white ghutra woven in Switzerland from West Indian Sea Island cotton, a matching Sea Island cotton Shumagh crafted in England, and a 3.50-metre cut of Swiss-made cotton-blend fabric for traditional tailoring. A selected fragrance completes the ensemble.

Distinguished by rare fibres, specialist European workmanship and an elegant presentation, the collection is conceived as a graceful gesture of appreciation during Ramadan — for family, friends or valued associates.

A gesture of generosity
